subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, "PRECIOUS" is written as "UOICERPS" and "FLAGRANT" is written as "NARGALFT". How will "CHILDISH" be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **All the letters except last one, the code for the word is found by writing the letters from right to left. 

 
• "PRECIOUS" is written as "UOICERPS" 
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/359f2b271bcf855f03e918fdf1602de05f40ea3bd051f473d6cc07324579de5a.png] 
 
 
 
• "FLAGRANT"
